documents.title: Bambu Filament Technical Data Sheet V2.0: PC
Bambu PC Safety Data Sheet SDS20251127C00
Bambu Lab Filament Hex Code Table: PC
Filament guide: printer, nozzle, AMS, build plate and glue compatibility

notes: Mechanical keys hold the TDS X-Y printed-specimen values; the registry has one key per scope, so the Z values (tensile 56 ± 2 MPa, elongation 2.1 ± 0.4 %, bending modulus 1620 ± 80 MPa, bending strength 55 ± 2 MPa, impact 9.0 ± 0.4 kJ/m²) are not stored.

TDS facts with no registry key are not stored: Young's modulus (X-Y 2110 ± 40 MPa, Z 1450 ± 60 MPa), melt index (32.2 ± 2.9 g/10 min at 260 °C, 2.16 kg), crystallization temperature (N/A), saturated water absorption (0.25 % at 25 °C, 55% RH), printing and storage humidity (< 20% RH, sealed with desiccant), bed surface preparation (PVP Glue), retraction length (0.8 - 1.4 mm) and speed (20 - 40 mm/s), chamber temperature (45 - 60 °C), max overhang (~ 70°), max bridging (~ 40 mm), spool material (PC + ABS, temperature resistance 90 °C) and spool size (200 × 67 mm), chemical resistance and flammability rows.
The TDS recommended chamber temperature (45 - 60 °C) is not written to thermal.chamber_temp: that key is a printer capability (number, template field chamber_temp_max), not a filament print setting.

Source disagreements kept for review: HDT load (TDS 117 °C at 1.8 MPa vs the ABS / ASA / PC wiki 117 ℃ at 0.45 MPa); nozzle temperature (TDS 260 - 280 °C vs material-table wiki 260 - 290 °C); bed temperature (TDS 90 - 110 °C vs material-table wiki 100 - 120 °C); AMS HT drying time (drying wiki and material-table 8 h vs ABS / ASA / PC wiki 12 h); AMS lite (product sources "not compatible" vs the material-table wiki's combined AMS / AMS lite column "Compatible"). The product TDS and the product-specific statements are kept.
Marketing prose proves no number: the store Highlights ("Exceptional Thermal Resistance", "High Impact Strength") are not stored as values.

The RoHS certificate on the store page (https://store.bblcdn.com/48b9ce9b1c1440489846d7ea78aaeeff.pdf) was not cached and not read, so safety.certifications is neither curated nor marked not_published.
No in-the-box list: no official packing list exists for this filament.
